parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule identifiers, compound names, and canonical SMILES for all molecules associated with the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by document ChEMBL ID. Require canonical SMILES to be present by using an INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Order results by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
